title: Two Store backends behind an existing interface
task: Implement two `jobs.Store` backends against the existing interface: an in-memory one, and a file-backed one where each job is a JSON file under a directory and `List` returns them in insertion order. Add a `Queue` with `Enqueue(job Job) error` and `Pending() ([]Job, error)` that works with any Store. Test both backends without duplicating the test body, and adding a third backend later must not mean editing Queue.
